observations: Three photos show a large, wall-mounted flat-screen TV with a black bezel.
The screen is off in all photos, reflecting the room: a sofa, windows, and electronics on a white table below.
Cables are visible behind the TV, connected to a power strip and various devices including a PS5 and a remote.
The TV is mounted on a light-colored wall above a white console table.
No visible damage to the bezel or frame is apparent in the photos.
The seller's text claims it is a 65" 4K UHD Sony TV KD-65XF8505 Android TV, but no model or brand is visible in the photos.
The screen appears dark and reflective, with no indication of screen damage (like cracks or dead pixels) from these angles.
